title: Metric Mix-Ups Lost A Spacecraft And 24,600 Pounds Of Fuel
hook: A metric mix-up left a plane 24,600 pounds short.
closing: Unit mistakes can destroy expensive machines or endanger people, so measurement standards matter.
question: Should every country use metric?

segments.say: Only 5% of people live in countries without official metric adoption, making mismatched systems unusually risky.
The Mars orbiter dropped to 57 kilometers, far below its planned altitude, and was lost.
The plane lacked 24,600 pounds of fuel, turning a unit mistake into an emergency glide.
